name: Wellington Turman
event: UFC Fight Night: Bonfim vs. Brady
summary: A Brazilian welterweight (18-8, age 30; Teixeira MMA in Connecticut) who returns from nearly three years out: his last fight was a R2 submission loss to Jared Gooden in December 2023, his third straight loss (3-6 UFC). LowKick reports four shoulder surgeries in the layoff. A July return against Islam Dulatov was cancelled on fight day when Dulatov was hospitalized; Turman had made weight.

how_they_fight.Striking: Muay Thai base. Calf kicks and a straight right; his best work comes in the clinch with short elbows, which bloodied Randy Brown's nose and swelled his eye in R3 (Cageside). Was knocked out in R1 twice in 2020-21 (Andrew Sanchez, Bruno Silva).
how_they_fight.Grappling: A submission threat: eight career submissions (six in R1), including an R2 armbar of Misha Cirkunov in the UFC (Wikipedia). Offensive wrestling is poor (30% takedowns, 0-for-10 against Silva and 0-for-5 against Brown in our data). Defensively, Andre Petroski took him down 8 times in 11 attempts.
how_they_fight.Defense: The weak spot: 51% striking defense, absorbs 4.2 strikes a minute, 49% takedown defense. Gooden hurt him with a right hook in R2, dropped him to his knees, then mounted him and finished with an RNC (MMA Junkie).
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Starts better than he finishes in recent fights: won or split R1 against Gooden and Brown, then lost R2 both times (MMA Junkie; Cageside). Rallied late in R3 against Brown. Stoppage losses came in R1 (two KOs) and R2 (one sub). His regional finishes were mostly R1-R2.
how_they_fight.Fight IQ: Gets drawn into wrestling exchanges he loses. Unknown after a near-three-year layoff and four shoulder surgeries.

patterns: Recent pattern: competitive R1, loses R2
Can be taken down and held
concerns: Ring rust: no fight since Dec. 2023
Shoulder after four surgeries, against a judo/sambo grappler
Durability: two R1 KO losses and a hurt-then-submitted R2 loss
keys_to_beat: Take him down and keep him there
Pressure him in R2 when his output has dropped in recent fights
Avoid his clinch elbows; take the clinch to the mat

news.text: Booked against Ko Seok-hyeon at welterweight for Nov. 7.

His return against Islam Dulatov was cancelled on fight day when Dulatov was hospitalized with an infection; Turman had weighed in at 170. Reported to have had four shoulder surgeries during the layoff.
